description: Evaluates bounded investment economics for compatible supply-chain network options.
responsibilities: Read exact network snapshot and scenario Resources without copying calculation payloads through chat.
Evaluate opening investment, recurring operating savings, NPV and payback through the approved deterministic capability.
Publish financial assumptions, exclusions and lineage as a durable financial_evaluation.v1 Artifact.
risks: Financial results are sensitive to horizon, discount rate, demand growth and excluded implementation costs.
A positive modeled NPV is decision evidence, not authorization to invest.
